Before embarking on their mission, the Legion Platoon visits Fairy Tail.
The Legion Platoon makes amends with Fairy Tail for their previous hostility against them.
It is later discovered that Fairy Tail has lost its title as the strongest guild in Fiore to Saber Tooth over the past seven years.
Sting and Rogue are two of the strongest wizards in Fairy Tail.
Sting and Rogue are a pair of Dragon Slayers.
Sting is obsessed with fighting Natsu.
Rogue is obsessed with fighting Gajeel.
Makarov brings Gildarts to their abandoned guildhall.
Makarov shows Gildarts Lumen Histoire, a light that Makarov says is Fairy Tail's greatest secret.
Makarov tells Gildarts that he has been chosen to become the next master of Fairy Tail.
Episode 152, 'And So We Aim for the Top', has the Japanese title 'Soshite Ore-tachi wa Chojo o Mezasu' and originally aired on October 13, 2012.
Episode 152 aired in English on November 24, 2015.
Natsu and his friends discover that a power gap has developed between them and the rest of the guild members who were not on Tenrou Island.
The group meets with Poluchka for medicine to strengthen their magic.
The group is unsuccessful in strengthening their magic with the medicine.
Wendy recognizes Poluchka's voice and scent as those of Grandine, the dragon who raised her.
Poluchka reveals herself as the Edolas counterpart of Grandine.
Poluchka gives Wendy written instructions for two advanced spells that Grandine failed to teach her.
Makarov announces Gildarts' succession as master to the rest of the guild.
Makarov finds that Gildarts has gone on a journey, leaving a letter of resignation behind.
In the letter, Gildarts reinstates Laxus into the guild.
In the letter, Gildarts returns mastership to Makarov.
In the letter, Gildarts tells Makarov to make Fairy Tail the strongest guild in Fiore again.
Romeo suggests they participate in the Grand Magic Games.
The Grand Magic Games are an annual festival designed to determine the guild rankings in Fiore.
Episode 153, 'Song of the Stars', has the Japanese title 'Hoshiboshi no Uta' and originally aired on October 20, 2012.
Episode 153 aired in English on December 1, 2015.
The Grand Magic Games are occurring in three months' time.
Natsu and his friends train at a beach resort.
On their second day of training, Virgo appears and tells the wizards that the Celestial Spirit World is in danger of destruction.
When the wizards arrive, they find a surprise party held by the Celestial Spirit King.
The party celebrates the wizards' return from Sirius Island after seven years.
The wizards spend the day in the spirit world partying with the spirits.
Virgo informs the wizards that one day in the spirit world equals three months in the human world.
The wizards find that the Grand Magic Games are upon them.
Episode 154, 'For All the Time We Missed Each Other', has the Japanese title 'Surechigatta Jikan no Bun dake' and originally aired on October 27, 2012.
Episode 154 aired in English on December 8, 2015.
While mulling over their lost training time, the Fairy Tail wizards receive a message via carrier pigeon.
The message requests a private meeting in the forest nearby.
At the meeting, the wizards meet a runaway Jellal, Ultear, and Merudy.
Jellal, Ultear, and Merudy have formed their own guild, Crime Sorciere.
Crime Sorciere aims to defeat Zeref and any dark guilds that try to use his power.
Jellal, Ultear, and Merudy ask Fairy Tail for help in determining the source of a magical anomaly similar to Zeref's magic.
The magical anomaly has been sensed around the Grand Magic Games arena, Domus Flau.
In exchange, Ultear uses her magic to invoke Fairy Tail's Second Origin in order to double their magic power.
Erza talks with Jellal over his regained memories.
Erza and Jellal nearly kiss.
Jellal decides that he and Erza can not be together.
Jellal lies to Erza that he has a fiancee.
Erza quickly picks up on the lie and respects his decision.
Erza sees Crime Sorciere off as they leave.
Episode 155, 'Crocus, the Flower-Blooming Capital', has the Japanese title 'Hanasaku Miyako: Kurokkasu' and originally aired on November 3, 2012.
Episode 155 aired in English on December 15, 2015.
Natsu, Lucy, Gray, Erza, and Wendy are chosen to represent their guild in the Grand Magic Games.
The Grand Magic Games are to be held in Fiore's capital, Crocus.
As they tour the city, Natsu and Happy encounter the twin dragon slayers, Sting and Rogue.
Sting and Rogue mock Natsu for not being able to kill Acnologia.
Sting and Rogue boast of becoming true dragon slayers by killing the dragons who raised them.
At midnight, Fairy Tail and the other participating guilds are put through a preliminary event.
The preliminary event is a race through a massive floating labyrinth.
The preliminary event is designed to narrow the number of participating guilds down to eight teams.
Episode 156, 'Sky Labyrinth', has the Japanese title 'Sukai Rabirinsu' and originally aired on November 10, 2012.
Episode 156 aired in English on December 22, 2015.
Natsu's team notices that Wendy has gone missing.
Elfman replaces Wendy to keep Natsu's team from being eliminated.
As they make their way through the enchanted labyrinth, the five encounter various other guilds.
The five steal the maps made by the other guilds to better navigate the maze.
The five reach the end of the maze and pass the elimination round.
The five are confident they have arrived first.
The five discover they have barely taken last place.
Happy, Lisanna, and the rest of the guild search for Wendy and Carla.
Happy, Lisanna, and the rest of the guild find Wendy and Carla in the garden of the king's palace, Mercurius.
Wendy and Carla have their magic power depleted.
Episode 157, 'New Guild', has the Japanese title 'Shinki Girudo' and originally aired on November 17, 2012.
Episode 157 aired in English on December 29, 2015.
Wendy's body is weakened as a result of losing her magic power.
Poluchka helps Wendy recover.
Wendy formally requests Elfman to take her place in the Grand Magic Games.
Fairy Tail steps into the arena with a negative audience reception.
Fairy Tail is bolstered by their guild mates and the spirit of Mavis, whom only Fairy Tail guild members can see.
The next four participating teams are Quatro Cerberus, Mermaid Heel, Blue Pegasus, and Lamia Scale.
Raven Tail is a former dark guild led by Makarov's son Ivan.
Raven Tail members confess to attacking Wendy and Carla.
The next team is a second team from Fairy Tail composed of Gajeel, Juvia, Mirajane, Laxus, and Jellal.
Jellal is disguised as Mystogan to help investigate the arena.
The final guild to be announced is Saber Tooth.
The audience cheers joyfully for Saber Tooth's announcement.
All eight teams are announced.
Each team sends out one member to participate in the first contest of the games.
Gray and Juvia represent their teams in the first contest.
Episode 158, 'Night of Shooting Stars', has the Japanese title 'Hoshi Furu Yoru ni' and originally aired on November 24, 2012.
Episode 158 aired in English on January 5, 2016.
The games' first contest, 'Hidden', requires the eight participants to score points by finding and attacking each other.
The contest takes place in a virtual city filled with copies of the participants.
Raven Tail member Nalpudding repeatedly targets Gray.
Gray scores last place in the contest.
Saber Tooth's Rufus scores first by using his Memory-Make magic to attack all the other participants at once.
Gray is humiliated and swears revenge against Raven Tail and Saber Tooth.
Lucy is chosen to fight Raven Tail member Flare in the tournament's first battle round.
Episode 159, 'Lucy vs. Flare', has the Japanese title 'Rushii vs. Furea' and originally aired on December 1, 2012.
Episode 159 aired in English on January 12, 2016.
Lucy displays tremendous skill in her battle against Flare by summoning two spirits simultaneously.
Flare cheats by using her magic hair to hold Alzack and Bisca's daughter, Asuka, as a hostage.
Flare blackmails Lucy into not fighting back to keep Flare from harming Asuka.
Lucy tearfully speaks of Asuka's danger.
Natsu hears Lucy and rushes to Asuka.
Natsu incinerates Flare's hair.
Lucy counterattacks with her Urano Metoria spell in combination with Gemini.
Flare's teammate Obra nullifies Lucy's magic before the spell fully activates.
Lucy collapses and loses the match.
Episode 160, 'Portent', has the Japanese title 'Kyozui' and originally aired on December 8, 2012.
Episode 160 aired in English on January 19, 2016.
Blue Pegasus' Ren defeats Mermaid Heel's Arana during the games' second match.
Saber Tooth's Orga effortlessly defeats Quatro Cerberus' War Cry in the third match.
For the day's fourth and final match, Jellal is pitted against Lamia Scale's Jura.
Jellal intends to avenge the humiliated Fairy Tail members.
Jellal mimics Mystogan's magic to keep up his disguise.
Jellal finds Mystogan's magic ineffective against Jura.
Jellal is forced to use his own magic instead.
Before Jellal can cast a spell that will expose his true identity, Ultear uses Merudy's sensory to force Jellal into submission.
The hospitalized Carla awakens after having a troubling premonition of the future.
Episode 161, 'Chariots', has the Japanese title 'Chariotto' and originally aired on December 15, 2012.
Episode 161 aired in English on January 26, 2016.
Fairy Tail is undaunted by their poor performance on the first day.
As the guild celebrates, they are visited and taunted by Bacchus.
Bacchus is Erza's rival from Quatro Cerberus.
Bacchus has come to replace War Cry.
Carla relays her premonition to Poluchka.
In Carla's premonition, Mercurius is collapsing around what appeared to be a tearfully singing Lucy.
The second day of the tournament begins with a footrace atop a train of moving chariots.
Natsu, Gajeel, and Sting suffer from motion sickness as a side effect of their Dragon Slayer magic.
Natsu responds to Sting that his determination is a result of the strength of Fairy Tail's bonds.
Sting eventually throws the race.
Natsu finishes as sixth place.
Gajeel finishes as seventh place.
Natsu and Gajeel earn Fairy Tail the audience's respect.
Episode 162, 'Elfman vs. Bacchus', has the Japanese title 'Erufuman vs. Bakkasu' and originally aired on December 22, 2012.
Episode 162 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Due to a miscommunication between the king and his knight Arcadios, Elfman is chosen as Bacchus' opponent instead of Erza.
Before the match, Bacchus and Elfman make a wager.
If Bacchus wins, he will court Elfman's sisters.
If Elfman wins, Bacchus' team name will be changed to 'Quatro Puppy' for the rest of the games.
Bacchus ruthlessly attacks Elfman with his bare palms.
Elfman damages Bacchus with his defensive Lizardman transformation.
Elfman outlasts Bacchus as Bacchus exhausts himself.
Elfman wins the match.
Bacchus' team is renamed.
Natsu finds Wendy, Carla, and Poluchka being kidnapped by a group of masked men.
The masked men claim they were hired to kidnap Lucy by Raven Tail.
The masked men are revealed to have actually been sent by Arcadios.
Arcadios intends to sow discord between the guilds.
Arcadios plots to use Lucy for his 'Eclipse Project'.
Episode 163, 'Mirajane vs. Jenny', has the Japanese title 'Mirajen vs. Jeni' and originally aired on January 5, 2013.
Episode 163 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
The second day of the Grand Magic Games continues.
Mirajane of Fairy Tail Team B fights against Jenny Realight of Team Blue Pegasus.
Mirajane and Jenny are well-known for being magazine models.
Their battle consists almost entirely of a fashion showdown.
Jenny proposes a wager that the loser must pose nude for the Sorcerer Magazine.
Mirajane accepts the wager.
Jenny transforms into her battle armor.
Mirajane shifts into her Satan Soul 'Sitri' form.
Mirajane easily defeats Jenny.
The final match of the day is Kagura Mikazuchi of Mermaid Heel against Yukino Aguria of Saber Tooth.
Yukino proposes to Kagura that they wager their lives on their battle.
Arcadios is confronted by Darton, the kingdom's defense minister, about his 'Eclipse Project'.
Episode 164, 'Kagura vs. Yukino', has the Japanese title 'Kagura vs. Yukino' and originally aired on January 12, 2013.
Episode 164 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Yukino is revealed to be a celestial spirit wizard when she summons Libra and Pisces to attack Kagura.
Kagura defeats Libra and Pisces using her gravity-altering magic.
Yukino uses a Gatekey that summons Ophiuchus, which is regarded as the strongest among the Celestial Spirits.
Kagura slays Ophiuchus with her sword still sheathed.
Kagura easily defeats Yukino.
Jellal discusses the fact that he has not sensed the evil power similar to Zeref's.
Jellal's discussion takes place after the second day of the Grand Magic Games has ended.
Erza reunites with Milliana.
Milliana is revealed to be a member of Mermaid Heel.
Saber Tooth's master Jiemma is dissatisfied with his guild's performance.
Sting is given another chance.
Jiemma humiliates Yukino for her failure.
Episode 165, 'Hatred at Nightfall', has the Japanese title 'Urami wa Yoru no Tobari ni Tsutsumarete' and originally aired on January 19, 2013.
Episode 165 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
After Yukino is expelled from Saber Tooth, she offers her two golden Gatekeys to Lucy.
Yukino offers the Gatekeys to complete Lucy's collection of the Zodiac Gatekeys.
Yukino states that when the twelve Zodiac Gatekeys are all gathered, a gateway that changes the world will open.
Lucy turns down the offer.
Milliana tells Erza that Kagura's sword, Archenemy, is intended to kill Jellal.
Milliana tells Erza that she and Kagura share the same resentment towards Jellal.
Natsu and Happy run after Yukino in an attempt to apologize.
Natsu realizes that Yukino had been expelled.
Natsu infiltrates the Crocus Garden to fight Jiemma.
Episode 166, 'Pandemonium', has the Japanese title 'Pandemoniumu' and originally aired on January 26, 2013.
Episode 166 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Natsu punches out Dobengal, the guild member summoned to fight him.
Natsu and Jiemma engage in a duel.
The guild master's daughter, Minerva, appears and ends their duel.
Minerva takes Happy hostage.
Minerva convinces Natsu to settle their dispute in the Grand Magic Games.
As Natsu leaves, he states that Saber Tooth will never surpass Fairy Tail because they care for their friends.
Rogue echoes Natsu's words.
Sting is left in awe at Natsu's strength.
The following day, an event called 'Pandemonium' begins.
In Pandemonium, participants enter a magical citadel filled with 100 monsters of varying strengths.
Participants individually do battle with any number of monsters they choose.
Erza, representing Fairy Tail Team A, requests the 100 monsters as her opponents.
Episode 167, '100 Against 1', has the Japanese title '100 tai 1' and originally aired on February 2, 2013.
Episode 167 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Erza kills the 100 monsters using various types of armor to match their strengths and weaknesses.
The crowd praises Fairy Tail.
Fairy Tail is awarded 10 points.
The game officials decide to determine the ranks of the remaining participants by means of a device called the 'Magic Power Finder', sometimes abbreviated as MPF.
Participants must attack the Magic Power Finder with their magic power.
The Magic Power Finder calculates and displays participants' equivalent scores based on the extent of power used.
Cana of Fairy Tail Team B dominates the event by using the Fairy Glitter spell lent to her by Mavis.
Makarov is surprised by Cana's use of the Fairy Glitter spell.
Fairy Tail Team B receives 8 points.
The audience bursts into a resounding swarm of cheers and claps due to the finish of the two Fairy Tail teams.
The masked leader Alexei tells his subordinates Flare, Obra, Nalpudding, and Kurohebi that it is about time to proceed with their true mission.
Raven Tail somehow got insider information regarding the battle matchups for the day.
Episode 168, 'Laxus vs. Alexei', has the Japanese title 'Rakusasu vs. Arekusei' and originally aired on February 9, 2013.
Episode 168 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
In the battle portion of the Grand Magic Games' third day, Milliana of Mermaid Heel beats Semmes of Quatro Puppy.
Saber Tooth's Rufus swiftly defeats Blue Pegasus' Eve.
Laxus of Fairy Tail Team B is chosen to battle against Alexei of Team Raven Tail.
The Fairy Tail members take extra precautions because Raven Tail is a suspicious guild.
Fairy Tail watches the actions of Ivan Dreyar and the other four Raven Tail members.
The spectators are shocked to see Laxus being beaten by Alexei.
No cautious movements can be seen from the Raven Tail team.
The two dueling people are illusions created by Alexei.
Alexei created the illusions so that he could have a talk with Laxus.
The other Raven Tail members being monitored by Fairy Tail are lifelike illusions.
In reality, the other Raven Tail members are with Alexei on the battlefield.
Alexei reveals himself to be Ivan Dreyar.
Ivan and the Raven Tail members are unable to interrogate Laxus about the Lumen Histoire's location.
Ivan and the Raven Tail members are forced to fight Laxus.
Before their battle begins, Ivan declares that Raven Tail is an anti-Fairy Tail guild.
Episode 169, 'Wendy vs. Shelia', has the Japanese title 'Wendi vs. Sheria' and originally aired on February 16, 2013.
Episode 169 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Laxus defeats Ivan and the four Raven Tail elite members.
Ivan's illusions disappear to the shock of everyone in the stadium.
The game officials declare Laxus the victor.
Ivan tells Laxus that Lumen Histoire is Fairy Tail's 'darkness'.
Raven Tail is disqualified for the remainder of the Games due to the infraction of the rules.
Raven Tail's members are captured by the soldiers.
Wendy of Fairy Tail Team A and Sherria Blendy of Team Lamia Scale face off for the final match of the day.
Sherria is revealed to be a Sky God Slayer.
Gusts of wind surround the arena as Sherria and Wendy exchange attacks.
Wendy employs an advanced Sky Dragon Slayer attack, much to Poluchka's astonishment.
Sherria falls on the ground.
Wendy is about to be announced as the winner of the bout.
Sherria suddenly stands up with her wounds fully healed.
The Crime Sorciere guild senses the nefarious aura.
Jellal proceeds to the Domus Flau audience.
Jellal is oblivious that he bumped into Doranbolt.
Doranbolt wonders what Mystogan is doing in Earthland.
Episode 170, 'Small Fists', has the Japanese title 'Chiisana Kobushi' and originally aired on February 23, 2013.
Episode 170 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Cheria is fully healed.
Wendy is almost depleted of magic power.
Cheria casts a high-level spell towards Wendy.
Wendy enhances Cheria's physical strength, causing the attack to miss Wendy.
The two competitors engage in hand-to-hand combat.
Due to the time limit and neither side giving up, their battle results in a draw.
The draw gives both teams 5 points.
Jellal tracks the sinister aura among the crowd in the form of a mysterious, hooded person.
Jellal is about to confront the aura source.
Doranbolt, Lahar, and other Rune Knights corner Jellal.
Doranbolt interrogates Jellal.
Jellal's cover is blown.
The Rune Knights, Kagura and Milliana see the true identity of Mystogan.
Yajima convinces the Rune Knights that Mystogan is Jellal's Edolas counterpart.
Lahar releases the fugitive.
Laxus and Makarov have a small conversation regarding Lumen Histoire.
Mavis appears and explains that Lumen Histoire is the 'light' of Fairy Tail.
Episode 171, 'Naval Battle', has the Japanese title 'Nabaru Batoru' and originally aired on March 2, 2013.
Episode 171 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
The jubilant Fairy Tail members celebrate their victories.
Sting, Kagura, and Milliana are contemplating their own concerns.
Yukino is enlisted as a sergeant under Arcadios' command.
The fourth day of the competitions begins with an event called 'Naval Battle'.
Naval Battle involves participants swimming in a giant water sphere and knocking the other competitors out.
After the other participants fall out of the sphere, a five-minute battle between Lucy and Minerva ensues.
Minerva quickly attacks Lucy and steals the keys of the Celestial Spirit mage.
Lucy refuses to surrender.
After hearing Lucy's intentions, Minerva stops attacking until the five-minute mark is reached.
Minerva resumes attacking Lucy until the game officials decide to halt the match.
The Fairy Tail members snap.
Minerva dangles Lucy out of the sphere.
The other Fairy Tail members rush to Lucy's aid.
Episode 172, 'A Parfum for You', has the Japanese title 'Kimi ni Sasageru Parufamu' and originally aired on March 9, 2013.
Episode 172 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Lucy is hospitalized and taken to the infirmary.
The Fairy Tail members warn Saber Tooth that they have angered the worst possible guild to do so.
Makarov announces that the two Fairy Tail teams must merge.
The merger is a result of the disqualification of Raven Tail.
The merger compensates for the odd number of teams for the battle round.
The new team will have the former Team A's 35 points to start with.
The new Fairy Tail team consists of Natsu, Gray, Erza, Gajeel, and Laxus.
The new team is well-received as they enter the field.
The second part of the tournament begins with a tag battle between Blue Pegasus' Ichiya and 'Rabbit' and Quatro Puppy's Rocker and Bacchus.
'Rabbit' is revealed to be Ichiya in disguise.
Bacchus punches the Exceed.
Ichiya bulks up to defeat the Quatro Puppy opponents.
Blue Pegasus is awarded 10 points.
Episode 173, 'Battle of Dragon Slayers!', has the Japanese title 'Batoru obu Doragon Sureiya' and originally aired on March 16, 2013.
Episode 173 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Mermaid Heel's Kagura and Milliana face off against Lamia Scale's Lyon and Yuka for the second tag battle of the games.
The second tag battle ends in a draw due to the time limit.
For the third and final match of the day, Natsu and Gajeel of Team Fairy Tail enter the field against Sting and Rogue of Team Saber Tooth.
Sting and Rogue were about to take the initiative when Natsu and Gajeel attacked them.
The audience watches in shock as the Fairy Tail Dragon Slayers overpower the Saber Tooth Dragon Slayers.
Sting activates 'White Drive'.
Rogue powers up using 'Shadow Drive'.
Episode 174, 'Four Dragons', has the Japanese title 'Yonin no Doragon' and originally aired on March 23, 2013.
Episode 174 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
Sting and Rogue begin attacking Natsu and Gajeel with their powers increased.
After receiving heavy blows from the Saber Tooth Dragon Slayers, Natsu and Gajeel manage to hold them off.
Sting and Rogue are forced to activate 'Dragon Force' on their own will.
The Fairy Tail audience is shocked by Sting and Rogue activating 'Dragon Force'.
Sting decides to finish the Fairy Tail Dragon Slayers alone.
Sting held a promise to his Exceed friend Lector many years ago.
The tide turns in favor of Sting as he unleashes a powerful attack on Natsu and Gajeel.
Sting's attack causes the collapse of the arena floor.
After a hand-to-hand combat underground, Sting is seemingly the victor of the match.
Natsu and Gajeel stand up, comment on Sting's strength, and argue about his position while attacking.
Natsu drags Gajeel on a mining cart and sends it away.
Gajeel is left incapacitated due to motion sickness.
Natsu challenges the Twin Dragons of Saber Tooth alone, in retribution for what Sting did earlier.
Episode 175, 'Natsu vs. the Twin Dragons', has the Japanese title 'Natsu vs. Soryu' and originally aired on March 30, 2013.
Episode 175 aired in English on September 1, 2015.
The tag battle of the Dragon Slayers comes to a close.
Natsu overpowers the combined attacks of Sting and Rogue.
The Saber Tooth members watch in dismay.
Jiemma seethes in anger over the defeat of the Twin Dragons.
Jiemma's anger frightens the nearby spectators away.
The rest of Fairy Tail celebrates in joy as its team receives 10 points.
Fairy Tail surpasses Team Saber Tooth by a single point.
Gajeel, back to his senses after being dragged by Natsu into a cart earlier, stumbles upon a cave full of dragon skeletons.
That night, Jellal manages to corner the source of the dark aura.
Jellal stands in disbelief at the identity of the mysterious, hooded person.
